options: 1 second for every 10 feet of vehicle length
explanation: Add 1 second when going over 40 mph.

body: Why is it dangerous to drive alongside other vehicles?
options: They may change lanes into you and you have less room to escape
explanation: Keep space on all sides.

explanation: Place them within 10 minutes of stopping.

subject: CDL

options: take your foot off the accelerator and let the vehicle slow
explanation: Front-wheel skids are often caused by driving too fast.

subject: CDL
body: Total stopping distance is made up of
options: perception distance, reaction distance and braking distance
explanation: Heavier vehicles take longer to stop.

subject: CDL
body: When going down a long, steep downgrade, you should
options: speed up to get it over quickly
ride the brakes the whole way
use a low gear and the engine's braking effect
explanation: Select the gear before starting down the hill.

subject: CDL
body: Before backing a large vehicle, the safest action is to
options: get out and check the area, and use a helper if possible
explanation: Back toward the driver's side when you can.

body: Placards are used to

warn others of the hazardous materials being carried
explanation: Placards go on all four sides of the vehicle.

subject: CDL
body: Who is responsible for checking cargo is secure?
explanation: Recheck cargo early in the trip and after breaks.

subject: CDL
body: Which vehicles must stop at all railroad crossings?
options: Buses carrying passengers and vehicles carrying placarded hazardous materials
explanation: Stop 15 to 50 feet from the nearest rail.

subject: CDL

explanation: 1 second per 10 feet = 5 s, plus 1 second because you are over 40 mph: 6 seconds.

subject: CDL

explanation: 1 second per 10 feet = 5 s: 5 seconds.

options: hold the steering wheel firmly and stay off the brake until the vehicle slows
explanation: Braking hard can cause loss of control.

rely on other drivers to see you
explanation: Large vehicles have big blind spots.

explanation: Select a low gear before the downgrade.

explanation: Give the tailgater room to pass.

subject: CDL
body: Overloading a vehicle can cause
options: poor steering, braking and speed control
explanation: Respect weight limits.

subject: CDL

explanation: Keep heavy cargo low and centred.

options: drive slowly to the next stop
not drive it until it is repaired
explanation: Driving an unsafe vehicle risks lives and penalties.

subject: CDL
